A table nested in a single-cell row renders as its own table

```elixir title="Elixir"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<table><tr><th>Summary</th></tr><tr><td>Before<table><tr><th>Item</th><th>Amount</th></tr><tr><td>Alpha</td><td>10</td></tr></table></td></tr></table>")
IO.inspect(result.content)
```
